tools.name: firecms_get_current_user
tools.title: Current user
tools.description: Get the currently authenticated FireCMS user

tools.name: list_firebase_projects
tools.title: List Firebase projects
tools.description:
List the Google Cloud / Firebase projects the signed-in user can access, and whether each one is ready to be connected to FireCMS Cloud.

Each entry reports:
- `fireCMSProject`: true if it is already connected to FireCMS Cloud
- `cloudProjectConfigurationStatus.firebaseEnabled` / `firestoreEnabled` / `apisEnabled` / `authEnabled`: what connecting requires

Connecting needs Firebase, Firestore and Firebase Authentication enabled.

tools.name: get_project_setup_status
tools.title: Check project setup
tools.description: Get the detailed FireCMS readiness status of a single Google Cloud project: whether Firebase, Firestore, Storage, Auth and the required APIs are enabled, and so what is still missing before it can be connected.

projectId.description: The Google Cloud / Firebase project ID

tools.name: list_firestore_locations
tools.title: List Firestore locations
tools.description: List the locations available for a new Firestore database, as location IDs such as 'eur3' or 'us-central'.

tools.name: enable_project_apis
tools.title: Enable required APIs
tools.description: Enable the Google Cloud APIs that FireCMS requires on a project (reported as `apisEnabled` in its setup status). Safe to run more than once.

projectId.description: The Google Cloud / Firebase project ID

tools.name: enable_firestore
tools.title: Create Firestore database
tools.description: Create the default Firestore database in a Google Cloud project, in the given location. The location is permanent and cannot be changed later.

projectId.description: The Google Cloud / Firebase project ID

tools.name: connect_project_to_firecms
tools.title: Connect a Firebase project
tools.description:
Connect an existing Firebase project to FireCMS Cloud.

It creates a delegated service account in the project with the permissions FireCMS needs, registers the signed-in user as an admin, creates the FireCMS project on the free plan, and by default adds FireCMS's access rule to the project's Firestore and Storage security rules.

Firebase, Firestore and Firebase Authentication must already be enabled on the project. Authentication cannot be enabled through any API: it is switched on once in the Firebase console. Fails if the project is already connected.

projectId.description: The Firebase project ID to connect

creationType.description: 'existing' (default) for a project that already has data; 'new' for a freshly created one

applySecurityRules.description: Add FireCMS's Firestore and Storage access rule as part of connecting (default true). The CMS cannot open any collection without it.

tools.name: apply_firestore_security_rules
tools.title: Apply FireCMS security rules
tools.description:
Add FireCMS's access rule to a project's Firestore and Storage security rules. Requires admin.

FireCMS Cloud reads the customer's Firestore from the browser using the signed-in user's own token, so it needs a rule granting access to users carrying the `fireCMSUser` claim:
    match /{document=**} { allow read, write: if request.auth.token.fireCMSUser; }

Without it the CMS shows "Missing Firestore Security Rules" and no collection opens, although this server keeps working: it reads through the backend's service account, which bypasses security rules.

The rule is injected into the existing ruleset rather than replacing it, and a project that already has it is left alone, so it is safe to run again. Connecting a project applies it already; this repairs projects connected earlier, or where that step failed.

tools.name: create_firecms_webapp
tools.title: Create FireCMS web app
tools.description: Create the FireCMS web app inside the client's Firebase project, or reuse the one already there. Connecting a project normally does this; this repairs a project where that step failed. Requires admin.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List all FireCMS Cloud projects accessible by the authenticated user

tools.name: get_root_collections
tools.title: List root collections
tools.description: List all Firestore root-level collections in a FireCMS project — the paths that can be turned into CMS collections. Read live from Firestore, so collections created moments ago are included.

tools.name: list_subcollections
tools.title: List subcollections
tools.description: List the subcollections of a specific document, with their full paths: nested data that can be turned into CMS collections.

parentDocumentPath.description: Full path of the parent document, e.g. 'users/abc123'

tools.name: list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List all users that have access to a FireCMS project, including their roles (admin, editor, viewer)

tools.name: add_user
tools.title: Invite a user
tools.description: Invite a new user to a FireCMS project. Sends an invitation email. Admin-only. If the email already belongs to a user of the project, their roles are replaced by these.

email.description: Email address of the user to invite

tools.name: update_user_roles
tools.title: Change user roles
tools.description: Update the roles of an existing user in a FireCMS project. Admin-only.

tools.name: remove_user
tools.title: Remove a user
tools.description: Remove a user from a FireCMS project, revoking their access. Admin-only.

tools.name: list_databases
tools.title: List Firestore databases
tools.description: List the Firestore databases of a project. Only needed for projects using more than the '(default)' database — the resulting database IDs can be passed to the other introspection and document tools.

tools.name: preview_inferred_schema
tools.title: Preview inferred schema
tools.description:
Read a sample of real documents from a Firestore path and infer a FireCMS collection schema from them, without saving anything. Works for any path, subcollections included.

Inference is structural only: it derives data types, enum candidates and validation from the sampled values. The result is a complete collection schema that can be edited and saved as it is.

sampleSize.description: How many documents to sample (default 30, max 200). More samples give better enum and optionality detection.

tools.name: infer_collections_from_data
tools.title: Create collections from data
tools.description:
Infer collections from the existing Firestore data at the given paths, and save them to the project. Requires admin.

For each path the backend samples documents, infers the property types, then uses an LLM to pick display names, a singular name, an icon, a navigation group and field widgets. Paths already mapped to a collection, and paths with no documents, are skipped.

paths.description: The collection paths to infer and save

tools.name: setup_all_collections
tools.title: Set up all collections
tools.description:
Discover every Firestore root collection in the project that is not yet mapped to a collection, infer a collection schema for each (display names and widgets picked by an LLM), and save them all. Requires admin.

Covers every database of the project. Collections that already exist are left alone, so it is safe to run again later to pick up new Firestore collections. Can take a while on large projects.

tools.name: get_project_config
tools.title: Get project settings
tools.description:
Get the full configuration for a FireCMS project, including:
- Project name, logo, and brand colors (primary/secondary)
- Subscription plan and trial status
- Feature toggles (text search, entity history, App Check)
- Default locale settings
- Customization revision info

tools.name: update_project_name
tools.title: Rename project
tools.description: Update the display name of a FireCMS project.

tools.name: update_project_colors
tools.title: Change brand colors
tools.description: Update the primary and/or secondary brand colors for the CMS UI. Colors should be hex values (e.g., '#0070F4').

tools.name: update_default_locale
tools.title: Change default locale
tools.description: Change the default locale for the CMS (affects date formatting, etc.).

tools.name: toggle_text_search
tools.title: Turn text search on or off
tools.description: Enable or disable the local text search feature for a project.

enabled.description: true to enable, false to disable

annotations.title: Turn text search on or off

tools.name: toggle_entity_history
tools.title: Turn entity history on or off
tools.description: Enable or disable entity history tracking (audit log of document changes) for a project.

enabled.description: true to enable, false to disable

annotations.title: Turn entity history on or off

tools.name: list_collection_schemas
tools.title: List collections
tools.description:
List all persisted collection schemas for a FireCMS project. Returns the collection 
configurations (name, path, properties, etc.) that define how data is displayed and edited in the CMS.

tools.name: get_collection_schema
tools.title: Get a collection
tools.description:
Get the full schema definition for a specific collection, including all properties, 
validation rules, display configuration, and subcollection definitions.

collectionId.description: Collection ID (usually same as the Firestore path, e.g., 'products')

tools.name: save_collection_schema
tools.title: Save a collection

dataType.description: The data type of this property

validation.description: Validation rules (e.g., { required: true, min: 0, max: 100 })

enumValues.description: Enum values for string/number fields (renders as select/chips)

markdown.description: For strings: render as markdown editor

url.description: For strings: treat as URL, optionally specify media type

of.description: For arrays: the property definition of array items

previewProperties.description: For references: properties to show in preview

disabled.description: If true, field is read-only in the form

columnWidth.description: Column width in pixels for table view

hideFromCollection.description: If true, hide from the table view

properties.description: Property definitions keyed by field name

tools.name: update_collection_schema
tools.title: Update a collection
tools.description: Partially update an existing collection schema. Only the top-level fields given are changed (merged with the existing schema): for example the name, group, display settings or properties.

data.description: Fields to update (merged with existing schema)

tools.name: delete_collection_schema
tools.title: Delete a collection
tools.description:
Delete a collection schema from FireCMS. This removes the collection configuration 
from the CMS — it does NOT delete the underlying Firestore data. The collection will simply 
no longer appear in the FireCMS UI.

tools.name: save_property
tools.title: Save a property

dataType.description: The data type of this property

validation.description: Validation rules (e.g., { required: true, min: 0, max: 100 })

enumValues.description: Enum values for string/number fields (renders as select/chips)

markdown.description: For strings: render as markdown editor

url.description: For strings: treat as URL, optionally specify media type

of.description: For arrays: the property definition of array items

previewProperties.description: For references: properties to show in preview

disabled.description: If true, field is read-only in the form

columnWidth.description: Column width in pixels for table view

hideFromCollection.description: If true, hide from the table view

namespace.description: Dot-separated namespace for nested properties in maps (e.g., 'address' for address.street)

tools.name: delete_property
tools.title: Delete a property
tools.description:
Remove a property from a collection schema. This removes the field definition from 
the CMS configuration — it does NOT delete the field from existing Firestore documents.

tools.name: generate_collection
tools.title: Generate a collection with AI
tools.description:
Generate a new FireCMS collection schema using AI. Provide a natural language description 
of the collection you want (e.g., "A blog with posts that have title, body, author, tags, 
and a featured image"). Returns a complete FireCMS collection configuration.

prompt.description: Natural language description of the collection to generate

existingCollections.description: Optional existing collection schemas for context

tools.name: modify_collection
tools.title: Modify a collection with AI
tools.description:
Modify an existing FireCMS collection schema using AI. Describe the changes you want 
(e.g., "Add a priority enum with low/medium/high" or "Make title required with max 100 chars").
Returns the updated schema and a list of operations performed.

existingCollection.description: The current collection schema to modify

existingCollections.description: Optional list of all collection schemas for context

tools.name: list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List documents from a Firestore collection, with optional filters, ordering and a limit.

limit.description: Max number of documents to return (default: 20)

tools.name: get_document
tools.title: Get a document
tools.description: Get a specific document by its collection path and ID. Returns all fields of the document.

tools.name: create_document
tools.title: Create a document
tools.description: Create a new document in a Firestore collection. Provide the field values as a JSON object.

data.description: Document fields as a JSON object

documentId.description: Optional document ID. If not provided, Firestore generates one. If a document with this ID exists, it is replaced.

tools.name: update_document
tools.title: Update a document
tools.description: Update fields of an existing document. Only the specified fields are modified (partial update / merge).

data.description: Fields to update as a JSON object

tools.name: delete_document
tools.title: Delete a document
tools.description: Delete a document from Firestore. This action is permanent.

tools.name: count_documents
tools.title: Count documents
tools.description: Count the total number of documents in a Firestore collection.

tools.name: export_collection
tools.title: Export a collection
tools.description:
Export documents from a Firestore collection as JSON. Useful for data backups,
analysis, or migration. For large collections, use the limit parameter.

tools.name: import_documents
tools.title: Import documents
tools.description: Bulk import documents into a Firestore collection, for seeding data, migrations or restoring a backup. Each document can specify an ID; without one, Firestore generates it. By default a document with an existing ID is overwritten; with merge: true its fields are merged instead. At most 500 documents per call.

merge.description: If true, merge with existing documents instead of overwriting (default: false)

tools.name: firecms_login
tools.title: Sign in to FireCMS
tools.description: Sign in to FireCMS Cloud. Opens a browser window for Google OAuth authentication. Required before using any other tools.

tools.name: firecms_logout
tools.title: Sign out of FireCMS
tools.description: Sign out of FireCMS Cloud. Revokes the current session.
